Mur2 f1i:1.en: At the time she said, Yahweh, cut out for yourself two tablets of stones like the first ones.
Mur2 f1i:1.notes: The phrase 'At the time she said' reflects a high-confidence repeated pattern for positions 2-4. 'Cut out for yourself' uses a paraphrased sense of the imperative verb at position 8, supported by repeated evidence for positions 8-9. 'Two tablets of stones' follows dominant repeated evidence for positions 10-12. 'Like the first ones' combines the preposition at position 13 with the adjective at position 14, supported by repeated patterns for positions 11-12-13 and 13-14.

The final clause is reconstructed and uncertain, with the suffix 'ך' indicating a second-person masculine singular addressee.

Mur2 f3:1.en: And this word of the remitting, letting loose all the lord, the loan his hand, which he will lend to neighbor

Mur2 f3:2.en: Not he will drive his fellow and his brother because he called remission to YHWH
Mur2 f3:2.notes: The translation conservatively follows the recoverable text, preserving grammatical structure and participants.
